item.title: Students and Tutors Clash With Government on Fee Hikes
item.description: Tuition fees under the modular curriculum rolled out in May 2025 have nearly doubled, rising from approximately KSh 56,000 to KSh 105,000 annually

item.title: Museveni Awards Son After U.S. Threats to Review Military Ties
item.description: Muhoozi remains in the spotlight over his controversial post-election remarks and diplomatic clashes with the U.S. over potential sanctions.

item.title: ODM Distances Itself From Oketch Salah

item.title: KeNHA Announces Closure of Major Nairobi Road, Lists Alternative Routes
item.description: In the notice, KeNHA listed alternative routes for affected motorists with drivers urged to slow down while approaching the said section of the road.

item.title: Huge Wildfire Breaks Out at Lake Nakuru National Park
item.description: This incident comes barely 3 weeks after a similar incident was reported at the nearby Mt. Longonot National Park.

item.title: Government Disburses Ksh 2.5B to Vulnerable Households

item.title: Govt Issues Urgent Statement on Spike in Armed Gang Raids
item.description: Kenyans have been worried about why the government has been quiet on this issue, prompting the National Police Service to release an urgent statement on the issue.

item.title: Govt Steps In After Video Shows Kenyan Worker Assaulted in Turkey
item.description: The case has renewed calls for better monitoring of recruitment agencies and increased awareness among Kenyans who are seeking work abroad.

item.description: The latest decision by the three African nations shows a growing continental effort to protect national currencies from misuse and damage.
